name: Investigator level 3
summary: Investigator; Gain expertise in Investigation or Insight. As a bonus action, study one creature, device, or scene you can see within 60 ft; until the end of your next turn, it counts as studied for your Investigator features. Uses: proficiency bonus per long rest.
